name: Alphastar
note: Version 1.0.59 / build 60 permits one service and one active appointment per patient, with gray booked hours and a shared three-patient limit per Philippine date. Includes staff-approval/payment guidance, a logout-style reschedule confirmation and readable service/status cards. Requires matching booking backend with patientActiveLimit 1 and singleService true. Existing development signing certificate retained; not Play Store or production-signing approval.
